rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeating that God wills to turn believers back makes the desire-followers' deviation answer only the last of the preceding clauses; without the repetition, it would oppose all three and erase their sense.
rows.anchor: كأن تكرار ذكر توبته للمؤمنين للدلالة على أن قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great deviation is violating the stated divine limits through forbidden acts, nullifying kinship and causal ties, permitting fornication, and rejecting God's upright way.
rows.anchor: والمراد بالميل العظيم هتك هذه الحدود الإلهية المذكورة في الآيات بإتيان المحارم وإلغاء تأثير الأنساب والأسباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human weakness stems from implanted sexual powers that continually contend for desired objects and urge people to pursue them.
rows.anchor: كون الإنسان ضعيفا لما ركب الله فيه القوى الشهوية التي لا تزال تنازعه في ما تتعلق به من المشتهيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God eases that pressure by permitting marriage and ownership of female slaves, breaking the force of desire and guiding this community along the way of earlier peoples.
rows.anchor: فمن الله عليهم بتشريع حلية ما تنكسر به سورة شهوتهم بتجويز النكاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He identifies an additional easing as the legislation of temporary marriage, which carries none of the burdens of ordinary marriage such as dowry and maintenance.
rows.anchor: وزادهم تخفيفا منه لهم لتشريع نكاح المتعة إذ ليس معه كلفة النكاح وما يستتبعه من أثقال الوظائف من صداق ونفقة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An unnamed view takes the easing to mean permission to marry slave women when necessary.
rows.anchor: وربما قيل إن المراد به إباحة نكاح الإماء عند الضرورة تخفيفا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī objects that this marriage already existed before Islam, though disliked; these verses remove aversion by affirming the enslaved woman's equal humanity and fitness for companionship.
rows.anchor: والذي ابتدعته هذه الآيات هو التسبب إلى نفي هذه الكراهة والنفرة ببيان أن الأمة كالحرة إنسان لا تفاوت بينهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address is plainly to believers in this community, so the easing is specific to them and means the legislation of temporary marriage described above.
rows.anchor: أن الخطاب فيها متوجه إلى المؤمنين من هذه الأمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human weakness is a general cause for easing, but earlier nations were kept from its effects by impediments; when repentance reached this community, mercy spread and the cause took effect.
rows.anchor: وعلى هذا فتعليل التخفيف بقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage forms one unit urging judicial justice and forbidding judges to favor wrongdoers over the rightful, while teaching that religion is a lived truth rather than a name.
rows.anchor: أنها ذات سياق واحد تتعرض للتوصية بالعدل في القضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He infers a theft, killing, or similar offense whose perpetrator was expected to mislead the Prophet in judgment by casting blame on an innocent person; God protected the Prophet.
rows.anchor: وأنه كان من المتوقع أن يهتموا بإضلال النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم في حكمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although betrayal often means breach of a trust, here the context points to theft and similar acts; because believers are like one self, violating another believer's property betrays the community.
rows.anchor: إن المؤمنين كنفس واحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His reconstruction is that some people stole, accused an innocent person, and pressed the Prophet to judge for the thief and against the accused.
rows.anchor: فالتدبر يقرب أن القصة كأنها سرقة وقعت من بعضهم ثم رفع الأمر إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فرمى بها السارق غيره ممن هو بريء منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage fits the reported occasion about Abu Tuʿmah ibn al-Abyraq's theft, though al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī cautions that most occasion reports apply remembered stories to verses they resemble.
rows.anchor: فالآيات أشد انطباقا على ما روي في سبب النزول من قصة سرقة أبي طعمة بن الأبيرق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verses establish the binding authority of the Prophet's judicial decisions.
rows.anchor: ويستفاد من الآيات حجية قضائه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage also establishes the Prophet's protection from error, alongside other religious truths to be discussed later.
rows.anchor: عصمته وحقائق اخر سيأتي بيانها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Verse 4:105 applies in a particular case what 2:213 states generally: God sent the Book to settle human disputes.
rows.anchor: وقد مر تفصيل القول فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unlike the general statement in 2:213, this verse grants the Messenger the right to judge and makes his own judgment authoritative.
rows.anchor: وتزيد عليها في أنها تدل على جعل حق الحكم لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم والحجية لرأيه ونظره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judging a concrete dispute requires the judge's own determination of which general rule applies; knowing the laws and rights alone does not settle the case.
rows.anchor: فإن العلم بكليات الأحكام وحقوق الناس أمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means God formed the Prophet's judgment and disclosed the ruling to him, not merely that He taught him general laws, as some have suggested.
rows.anchor: فالمراد بالإراءة في قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught the Prophet the Book's rules and wisdom, then added the judgment He gave him so the Prophet could adjudicate and end disputes.
rows.anchor: أن الله أنزل إليك الكتاب وعلمك أحكامه وشرائعه وحكمه لتضيف إليها ما أوجد لك من الرأي وعرفك من الحكم فتحكم بين الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition is coordinated with the preceding declarative sentence, which functions as a command: judge among them and do not advocate for traitors.
rows.anchor: عطف على ما تقدمه من الجملة الخبرية لكونها في معنى الإنشاء كأنه قيل فاحكم بينهم ولا تكن للخائنين خصيما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A khasim is someone who defends a claim or its equivalent.
rows.anchor: والخصيم هو الذي يدافع عن الدعوى وما في حكمها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is forbidden to defend traitors against people claiming their rights, thereby voiding the rightful party's claim.
rows.anchor: وفيه نهيه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم عن أن يكون خصيما للخائنين على من يطالبهم بحقوقه فيدافع عن الخائنين ويبطل حقوق المحقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The context suggests betrayal means any wrongful violation of another's rights, not only breach of entrusted deposits, though a specific case could sometimes be attached to a general rule.
rows.anchor: أن المراد بالخيانة مطلق التعدي على حقوق الغير ممن لا ينبغي منه ذلك لا خصوص الخيانة للودائع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here seeking forgiveness means asking God to shield a person from the human disposition to usurp rights and follow desire.
rows.anchor: أن يطلب من الله سبحانه الستر على ما في طبع الإنسان من إمكان هضم الحقوق والميل إلى الهوى ومغفرة ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet did not commit a consequential sin or approach a blameworthy act; he asks God to keep him from ego-driven defense of treachery, as 4:113 confirms his divine protection.
rows.anchor: بل ليسأل من الله أن يظهره على هوى النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Infallibility excludes partial judgment between strong and weak, friend and enemy, Muslim and protected non-Muslim, or near and distant kin.
rows.anchor: ومن الجور والميل إلى الهوى المذموم أن يفرق في حكمه بين قوي وضعيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even an infallible Prophet depends on God for this protection and cannot dispense with Him, since God remains free to act as He wills.
rows.anchor: ولا ريب في حاجته في ذلك إلى ربه وعدم استغنائه عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cited verses say each person bears their own deeds and cannot transfer their sins to another, framing the warning against accusing an innocent person.
rows.anchor: لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib distinguishes erring from hitting the mark: intending one thing but producing another is akhtaʾa, while producing what one intended is aṣāba.
rows.anchor: قال الراغب في المفردات إن من أراد شيئا فاتفق منه غيره يقال أخطأ وإن وقع منه كما أراده يقال أصاب

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib notes that an unsuitable act or an unbecoming intention can also be called an error.
rows.anchor: وقد يقال لمن فعل فعلا لا يحسن أو أراد إرادة لا تجمل إنه أخطأ

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib says khatiʾa and sayyiʾa are close, but khatiʾa usually denotes an unintended outcome produced by an intention, such as accidentally hitting a person while hunting.
rows.anchor: لكن الخطيئة أكثر ما تقال فيما لا يكون مقصودا إليه في نفسه

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib distinguishes prohibited causes, like drinking intoxicants, from permissible causes, like hunting; he cites 33:5 on unintended acts versus what hearts intend.
rows.anchor: والسبب سببان سبب محظور فعله كشرب المسكر وما يتولد عنه من الخطأ غير متجاف عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī treats khatiʾa as an adjective whose noun is elided through common use; the pattern faʿil suggests an event lodged and settled in an act.
rows.anchor: وأظن أن الخطيئة من الأوصاف التي استغني عن موصوفاتها بكثرة الاستعمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Error originally means an unintended act, then broadens to any act a sound natural disposition should not intend; sin and its consequences become errors by extension.
rows.anchor: والخطأ الفعل الواقع الذي لا يقصده الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khatiʾa can mean an unintended, non-sinful act or an act one ought not intend and so incurs sin; because the verse says it is acquired, the latter sense is intended here.
rows.anchor: لكن الله سبحانه لما نسبها في قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following 2:219, ithm is an act whose burden deprives a person of many benefits, lowers their social standing, and destroys public trust.
rows.anchor: أن الإثم هو العمل الذي يوجب بوباله حرمان الإنسان عن خيرات كثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disjunctive pair distinguishes a sin with limited consequences, such as omitting a fast or eating blood, from a sin with lasting consequences, such as murder or theft; falsely assigning either to an innocent is clear slander and sin.
rows.anchor: أن من يكسب معصية لا تتجاوز موردها وبالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling an accusation a throwing and accepting its guilt a burden creates a metaphor: the slanderer wounds the innocent like an arrow and saddles them with a lifelong load.
rows.anchor: وفي تسمية نسبة العمل السيء إلى الغير رميا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The group is the same people addressed in 4:109 for arguing on behalf of others, corresponding to the people of Abu Tuʿmah.
rows.anchor: وينطبق على قوم أبي طعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The group misleads only itself because its attempted action is sinful and every sin is a form of error; the misguidance does not reach the Prophet.
rows.anchor: فهم الضالون بما هموا به لأنه معصية وكل معصية ضلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He mentions another sense previously discussed for this phrase at 3:69 but says it does not fit the present context.
rows.anchor: لكنه لا يناسب هذا المقام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The apparent absolute denial of harm is restricted by the following clause about God's sending down the Book, construed as a circumstantial clause; grammarians usually expect qad before a past-tense verbal clause there.
rows.anchor: غير أن ظاهر السياق أنه مقيد بقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In context, the clause denies that people can harm the Prophet in any respect, in knowledge or action.
rows.anchor: وعلى هذا فالكلام مسوق لنفي إضرار الناس مطلقا بالنبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم في علم أو عمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The divine revelation and teaching explains why their attempts cannot mislead or harm the Prophet: it is the basis of his infallibility.
rows.anchor: فهذا الإنزال والتعليم هو المانع من تأثيرهم في إضلاله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فهو الملاك في عصمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse presents infallibility as a kind of knowledge that prevents its possessor from committing sin and error, as settled dispositions such as courage or chastity produce their effects and block opposites.
rows.anchor: ظاهر الآية ان الأمر الذي تتحقق به العصمة نوع من العلم يمنع صاحبه عن التلبس بالمعصية والخطأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinary beneficial knowledge and wisdom generally keep a person from vice, but like other natural causes they do not prevent every lapse; learned and pious people can still err.
rows.anchor: والعلم النافع والحكمة البالغة وإن كانا يوجبان تنزه صاحبهما عن الوقوع في مهالك الرذائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human faculties compete: desire can distract a pious person from awareness of piety or weaken that awareness, allowing appetite to prevail; other motivational causes work similarly.
rows.anchor: والوجه في ذلك ان القوى الشعورية المختلفة في الإنسان يوجب بعضها ذهوله عن حكم البعض الآخر أو ضعف التفاته إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Infallibility is a cognitive cause that is never overpowered; ordinary forms of acquired awareness could sometimes fail, so this knowledge differs from them.
rows.anchor: ومن هنا يظهر أن هذه القوة المسماة بقوة العصمة سبب شعوري علمي غير مغلوب البتة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God points to this special knowledge in His address specifically to the Prophet, saying He taught him what he had not known.
rows.anchor: وقد أشار الله تعالى إليه في خطابه الذي خص به نبيه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The descent onto the Prophet's heart by Gabriel and the Trustworthy Spirit in 2:97 and 26:192–195 shows that the descent described here is a kind of knowledge and revelation.
rows.anchor: أن الإنزال المذكور من نسخ العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other verses describe God's communication to the Prophet as revelation, supporting the identification of this teaching with divine revelation.
rows.anchor: ويظهر من جهة أخرى أن ذلك من قبيل الوحي والتكليم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The final phrase is not limited to what the Book and wisdom teach: the context concerns the Prophet's personal judgment in disputes, which depends on but is distinct from those general teachings.
rows.anchor: فإن مورد الآية قضاء النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم في الحوادث الواقعة والدعاوي التي ترفع إليه برأيه الخاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse names two kinds of teaching: revelation through the angel, and divine inspiration or a hidden casting into the Prophet's heart without an angel's descent.
rows.anchor: ومن هنا يظهر أن المراد بالانزال والتعليم في

rows.speaker: الروايات
rows.claim: Reports about the Prophet's knowledge support a second kind of divine teaching: hidden inspiration into the heart without an angel's descent.
rows.anchor: وهذا هو الذي تؤيده الروايات الواردة في علم النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is knowledge God gives directly; ordinary means by which people acquire knowledge would not suffice to provide it.
rows.anchor: آتاك نوعا من العلم لو لم يؤتك إياه من لدنه لم يكفك في إيتائه الأسباب العادية التي تعلم الانسان ما يكتسبه من العلوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This divine gift of infallibility is a kind of knowledge unlike ordinary knowledge: it dominates other faculties and therefore protects its possessor from error and sin absolutely.
rows.anchor: هذه الموهبة الالهية التي نسميها قوة العصمة نوع من العلم والشعور يغاير سائر انواع العلوم في أنه غير مغلوب لشيء من القوى الشعورية البتة

rows.speaker: الروايات
rows.claim: Reports say the Prophet and Imam have a spirit called the Holy Spirit that supports and protects them from sin and error.
rows.anchor: وقد ورد في الروايات أن للنبي والامام روحا تسمى روح القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Read literally, 42:52's Spirit from God's command is a teaching, guiding word cast to the Prophet.
rows.anchor: بتنزيل الآية على ظاهرها من إلقاء كلمة الروح المعلمة الهادية إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the interpretation he will later give 21:73, the verse refers to the Holy Spirit's support of the Imam in good deeds and worship.
rows.anchor: المراد به تسديد روح القدس الامام بفعل الخيرات وعبادة الله سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book means revelation sent to resolve people's disagreements, as described generally in 2:213.
rows.anchor: هو الوحي النازل لرفع اختلافات الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wisdom means the other divine teachings revealed through revelation, beneficial in this life and the next.
rows.anchor: والمراد بالحكمة سائر المعارف الالهية النازلة بالوحي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means knowledge beyond the general and universal teachings contained in the Book and wisdom.
rows.anchor: غير المعارف الكلية العامة من الكتاب والحكمة

rows.speaker: بعض المفسرين
rows.claim: Some commentators identify the Book with the Qur'an, wisdom with its rulings, and the knowledge beyond it with rulings and unseen matters; al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī says this reading is weak.
rows.anchor: فقد فسر بعضهم الكتاب بالقرآن

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Others identify the Book and wisdom with Qur'an and Sunna, and the extra knowledge with laws, histories of earlier messengers, and other sciences; he rejects this too.
rows.anchor: وفسر بعضهم الكتاب والحكمة بالقرآن والسنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that God's favor to the Prophet was great is an expression of benefaction.
rows.anchor: امتنان على النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: Al-Raghib defines najwa as private conversation, originally meeting alone in a secluded place; it can also name the people whispering, as in 17:47.
rows.anchor: قال الراغب وناجيته أي ساررته وأصله أن تخلو به في نجوة من الأرض

words: لَا خَيْرَ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّن نَّجْوَىٰهُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the reading that these verses form one continuous passage, the discussion returns to 4:108 but generalizes from plotting at night to all private talk.
rows.anchor: بناء على اتصال الآيات وقد عمم البيان لمطلق المسارة في القول سواء كان ذلك بطريق التبييت

words: لَا خَيْرَ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّن نَّجْوَىٰهُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The judgment concerns private conversation generally, whether or not it takes the form of a nighttime plot; he compares this to the general scope of 4:115's opposition to the Messenger.
rows.anchor: لأن الحكم المذكور وهو انتفاء الخير فيه إنما هو لمطلق المسارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception is disconnected: rather, some good lies in the private talk of one who enjoins charity, good conduct, or reconciliation.
rows.anchor: والمعنى لكن من أمر بكذا وكذا فيه ففيما أمر به شيء من الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling a private appeal to good an act of command is metaphorical; the verse names charity, good conduct, and reconciliation as the three good ends.
rows.anchor: وقد سمى دعوة النجوى إلى الخير أمرا وذلك من قبيل الاستعارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Charity is singled out from good conduct, although it is one of its forms, because it is the most complete example and often especially calls for private discussion.
rows.anchor: ولعل إفراد الصدقة عن المعروف مع كونها من أفراده لكونها الفرد الكامل في الاحتياج إلى النجوى بالطبع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person who privately enjoins good or reconciliation seeking God's approval will receive a great reward.
rows.anchor: أحدهما من يفعل ذلك ابتغاء مراضاة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The other person privately speaks to oppose the Messenger and leave the believers' path; the outcome is divine reprieve and drawing-on to destruction, then Hell.
rows.anchor: وثانيهما أن يفعل ذلك لمشاقة الرسول واتخاذ طريق غير طريق المؤمنين وسبيلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mushāqqa comes from shiq, a separated part; being on another side is a metaphor for opposition and disagreement.
rows.anchor: المشاقة من الشق وهو القطعة المبانة من الشيء فالمشاقة والشقاق كونك في شق غير شق صاحبك

words: مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Opposing the Messenger after guidance becomes clear means opposing and disobeying him; following a path other than the believers' restates this opposition, since their path is obedience to the Messenger and thus to God.
rows.anchor: فالمراد بمشاقة الرسول بعد تبين الهدى مخالفته وعدم إطاعته
